name: shadow-compact
description: Verified-checkpoint compaction for Claude Code: a private builder and independent verifier prepare an evidence-grounded checkpoint in the background, and Claude Code's own /compact or auto-compaction installs it through session.compact with the exact recent tail preserved by handle.

prepareThresholdTokens.title: Checkpoint threshold (tokens)
prepareThresholdTokens.description: Absolute context token count at which background checkpoint preparation starts. Must be a positive integer below the auto-compact window so the checkpoint is ready before Claude Code compacts.

configureAutoCompactWindow.title: Set Claude's auto-compact window
configureAutoCompactWindow.description: On a model's first session, set Claude Code's auto-compact window (as /autocompact does, saved per model) unless a window is already chosen in settings or CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW.

autoCompactWindowTokens.title: Auto-compact window (tokens)
autoCompactWindowTokens.description: Window Shadow sets for Claude Code auto-compaction. The engine compacts somewhat below it (~175k for 190k); keep it above the checkpoint threshold.

recentTurns.title: Recent turns kept verbatim
recentTurns.description: Minimum number of recent user-anchored turns preserved exactly (by engine handle) after the checkpoint.

builderModel.title: Builder model
builderModel.description: Model alias or id for the private checkpoint-builder agent; haiku keeps cost low, inherit uses the session model.

verifierModel.title: Verifier model
verifierModel.description: Model alias or id for the private checkpoint-verifier agent; haiku keeps cost low, inherit uses the session model.

manualCompactMode.title: Manual /compact mode
manualCompactMode.description: shadow answers /compact with the verified checkpoint when one covers the transcript; native always defers to Claude Code compaction.
